description: This file defines the 'PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator' class, which provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'PerformanceTrackerLog' entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to access and modify related entities such as Employee, User, and PerformanceTracker, as well as retrieving formatted date strings for added and modified dates.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for enhancing the PerformanceTrackerLog entity with additional methods for date formatting and entity associations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTrackerLog entity instance.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped PerformanceTrackerLog entity.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted added date of the performance tracker log, or null if not set.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted modified date of the performance tracker log, or null if not set.

methods.name: setReviewerByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee (reviewer) associated with the log by employee number.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the log based on user ID.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerById
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker entity with the log by tracker ID.
